name: Creamy Mushroom, Miso & Parmesan
desc: Miso deepens the mushroom flavour without turning it into a miso soup.
method: Add mushrooms, onion, garlic, thyme, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add miso, cream, Parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Blend briefly until glossy and completely smooth.
science: Mushrooms, aged cheese and miso layer different sources of savouriness.
note: Add miso after the cook for a cleaner flavour.

name: Tomato, Mascarpone & Parmesan
desc: Dense, rich tomato soup rather than watery café tomato.
ing: ½ tsp dried basil or oregano
method: Add tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, purée, herbs, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add mascarpone, Parmesan, pepper and balsamic.
Blend briefly until velvety.
science: Tomatoes and peppers contribute carotenoids; dairy adds fat that assists absorption of fat-soluble carotenoids.

name: Porcini, Truffle & Parmesan
desc: The luxury mushroom soup: earthy, nutty and unapologetically umami.
ing: ½–1 tsp truffle oil or truffle paste
method: Add fresh mushrooms, dried porcini, onion, garlic, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add cream, Parmesan, truffle and pepper.
Blend briefly.
science: Dried porcini dramatically increase savoury intensity.
note: Truffle should finish the soup, not swamp it.

name: Tomato, Red Pepper & Mascarpone
desc: A thick, rich tomato soup with roasted pepper and mascarpone.
method: Add 400 g chopped tomatoes, 180 g roasted red peppers, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 70 g mascarpone, black pepper, ½ tsp balsamic vinegar.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Tomato and pepper provide carotenoids and vitamin C; mascarpone provides richness and helps carry fat-soluble flavours.
note: Balsamic should disappear into the background.

name: Roasted Red Pepper, Tomato & Feta
desc: Sweet roasted pepper held in savoury balance by feta, garlic and smoked paprika.
method: Add 320 g roasted red pepper, 280 g chopped tomatoes, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, ½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 70 g feta, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Peppers and tomatoes are rich in carotenoids; feta adds protein and calcium.
note: Jarred peppers make this low-waste and easy.

name: Tomato, Mascarpone & Basil
desc: Classic tomato and basil made properly dense, creamy and garlicky.
method: Add 400 g chopped tomatoes, 150 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 70 g mascarpone, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Tomato provides lycopene; dairy adds fat that can improve absorption of fat-soluble carotenoids.
note: Use fresh basil as a topping only if convenient; dried basil is more practical.

name: Cauliflower, Roasted Garlic & Mature Cheddar
desc: Pale, thick and cheesy with enough garlic to keep cauliflower interesting.
method: Add 450 g cauliflower florets, ½ onion, 5 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 70 g mature cheddar, 60 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Cauliflower provides vitamin C and fibre while Cheddar contributes protein and calcium.
note: Cheddar and stock are salty, so season at the end.

name: Cauliflower, Parmesan & Garlic
desc: A cleaner, more savoury cauliflower soup built around Parmesan and garlic.
method: Add 480 g cauliflower florets, ½ onion, 5 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 35 g parmesan, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Cauliflower supplies vitamin C and fibre; Parmesan adds protein, calcium and umami.
note: One of the simplest low-waste soups in the collection.

name: Pea, Mint & Crème Fraîche
desc: Bright pea soup made smooth and creamy without potato.
method: Add 400 g frozen peas, ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube, 390 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 g crème fraîche, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Peas provide fibre, folate and plant protein.
note: Mint should be subtle; frozen peas already bring plenty of flavour.

name: Carrot, Ginger, Coconut & Chilli
desc: Carrot soup steered away from sweetness with ginger, garlic and medium chilli.
method: Add 480 g carrots, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 15 g ginger, 1 vegetable stock cube, 330 ml water and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 150 ml light coconut milk, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Carrots are rich in beta-carotene; coconut provides fat that assists absorption of fat-soluble carotenoids.
note: Keep the chilli warm rather than punishing.

name: French Onion-Inspired Gruyère Cream
desc: Onion and Gruyère designed around the soup maker's inability to caramelise properly.
method: Add 350 g onions, 120 g chestnut mushrooms, 3 garlic cloves, 1 vegetable stock cube, 400 ml water, 1 tsp worcestershire-style vegetarian relish and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 55 g gruyère, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Mushroom and cheese restore some of the savoury depth normally created by prolonged browning.
note: This is intentionally 'inspired' rather than claiming to replicate caramelised French onion soup.

name: Curried Cauliflower Cream
desc: Mild curry spice, garlic and cauliflower with a coconut finish.
method: Add 450 g cauliflower, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 10 g ginger, 1 tsp mild curry powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 vegetable stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 120 ml light coconut milk, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Cauliflower contributes vitamin C and fibre; turmeric and spices are here primarily for flavour.
